verdict.rationale: Brex markets "fast global payments" on its business account and describes itself as a global payments platform, so sending money abroad is plausibly supported. Nothing shows transfers arriving in under a minute, and the Payments API lists only ACH, domestic wires and checks. Missing for 10: any documented international transfer rail, any stated delivery time (let alone under a minute), and independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-border payment speed.
